description: This file defines utility classes and functions for managing weak references to torch.Tensor objects, including custom weak reference wrappers and weak key dictionaries that use object identity for hashing, specifically tailored for handling tensors in PyTorch.

classes.name: _IterationGuard
classes.description: Context manager to safely iterate over weak containers, delaying removals until iteration is complete.

classes.name: WeakIdRef
classes.description: Custom weak reference that caches the object's id for use as a hash, suitable for tensor objects.

classes.name: _WeakHashRef
classes.description: Weak reference that uses the object's hash for equality and hashing, handling tensor objects.

classes.name: WeakIdKeyDictionary
classes.description: A variant of a weak key dictionary that uses object identity (__eq__ and __hash__ based on id) for keys, tailored for tensors.

classes.name: TensorWeakRef
classes.description: Wrapper around a weak reference to a torch.Tensor that manages _fix_weakref calls upon unwrapping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for classes, initializing weak references or dictionaries.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Returns the referenced object, with special handling for tensor resurrection.

methods.name: __hash__
methods.description: Returns the cached id or hash of the referenced object.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Checks equality based on object identity or hash, depending on class.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the weak key dictionary.

methods.name: __deepcopy__
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the weak key dictionary.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key, returning default if not found.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Yields key-value pairs from the dictionary.

methods.name: popitem
methods.description: Removes and returns an arbitrary key-value pair.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes a specified key and returns its value.

methods.name: setdefault
methods.description: Returns the value for a key if present, otherwise sets it to default.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the dictionary with key-value pairs from another dict or iterable.
